name: Personal Brand Strategy
description: Defines professional positioning including unique value proposition, target audience, platform selection, content themes, and a 90-day visibility plan. Produces a complete brand strategy document. Use when the user wants to build a personal brand, establish thought leadership, increase professional visibility, or create a content strategy for career growth. Do NOT use for LinkedIn profile writing (use linkedin-summary-writer), resume writing (use resume-bullet-writer), or social media marketing for a business (use content-marketing skills).
